title: Creation and Consumption of Mobile Word of Mouth: How Are Mobile Reviews Different?
authors: Sam Ransbotham; Nicholas H. Lurie; Hongju Liu
main_or_robustness: main (cross-sectional comparison of mobile vs nonmobile reviews; Poisson/OLS with user FE, CEM matching, Rosenbaum bounds)

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: cross-sectional mobile-vs-desktop review comparison (lm/felm with user FE, Poisson glm, lmer, CEM att); no staggered adoption
Poisson glm with quarter trend and a single common AfterMobile date x polynomial time trend; nonlinear, common timing, trends

eligible_reason: Not a staggered DiD. Review-level comparison of mobile vs nonmobile word of mouth; Table 8 uses a single common AfterMobile break in Poisson models with time trends.
design_notes: R script MobileReview_analysis_20180530.txt (CRLF). Treatment ReviewMobile is a review attribute, not a unit-level adoption date.
data_files_note: readme: no data shipped; the R code simulates a 100,000-review dataset (rnorm/sample) that will not match the paper.
data_provenance_note: Data simulated inside the R script (section B).
software_notes: R (lfe, plm, pglm, lme4, cem, Matching)
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read; package_mismatch checked against title, authors and README.
